capabilities: open configured notes and new empty tabs in the left or right sidebar via commands
move the active tab between sidebars and the main area while keeping its scroll position
move core views such as Files, Search, or Bookmarks between sidebars
open today's daily note directly in a sidebar using core Daily notes settings
close, deduplicate, and auto-pin sidebar note tabs
extras: On desktop the functionality is already built into Obsidian, so the plugin targets the mobile app; it is installed manually from GitHub releases.
intentEvidence: this functionality is already built-in on desktop
problem: The Obsidian mobile app has no built-in way to open notes or new tabs in the sidebars, which desktop already supports natively.
summary: Adds commands to open notes and new tabs in the mobile app's sidebars, move tabs between sidebars and the main area, and manage sidebar tabs.
